reading: Comcast Corporation is a publicly traded telecommunications and media conglomerate headquartered in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, listed on NASDAQ under ticker CMCSA and filing with the SEC under CIK 0001166691. Its business spans Xfinity residential cable and internet service, Comcast Business enterprise connectivity, and the NBCUniversal and Sky media properties. The Michigan facility recorded in this registry appears in third-party data center directories as part of Comcast's network infrastructure footprint, most likely supporting regional cable, internet, and Comcast Business services rather than functioning as a wholesale colocation product marketed to outside enterprise tenants. As one of the largest telecommunications companies in the United States, Comcast's corporate financials and SEC filings are extensively documented, but facility-level detail for individual network sites like this Michigan location is not typically broken out in the company's public disclosures, so this registry records the facility's specific role and capacity as not published pending further site-level research.
